# Awesome Finance Agents

> Open-source LLM agents for finance, organized by financial function.
> 按金融职能组织的开源 LLM 金融 agent 精选清单。

Site: https://finance-agents.dev/
中文: https://finance-agents.dev/zh/
GitHub: https://github.com/aowang-ai/awesome-finance-agents
Full text for models: https://finance-agents.dev/llms-full.txt
Every page has a Markdown copy: add .md to its URL (Chinese pages under /zh/).

## Chapters / 章节

1. [Data and Tools](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/1-data-and-tools.md) — market and filing data, MCP servers, official broker and exchange kits, skills
2. [Investment Research](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/2-investment-research-and-deep-research.md) — filings and news → source-backed memos; self-hosted research workbenches
3. [Multi-Agent Decisions](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/3-multi-agent-research-and-decision-systems.md) — specialized agents debate and hand off
4. [Trading and Portfolio](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/4-trading-execution-and-portfolio-management.md) — signal → sized, risk-checked order; prediction-market agents
5. [Quant Automation](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/5-quantitative-research-automation.md) — factors and strategy iteration
6. [Accounting](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/6-finance-operations-and-accounting.md) — bookkeeping, tax and invoicing, accounting-system MCP
7. [Risk and Compliance](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/7-risk-compliance-and-audit.md) — AML/KYC, DD, gated actions
8. [Personal Finance](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/8-personal-finance.md) — local-first budgets and accounts
9. [Evaluation and Arenas](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/9-evaluation-benchmarks-and-arenas.md) — benchmarks, live arenas, public track records
10. [Backtest and Leakage](https://finance-agents.dev/chapters/10-backtesting-replay-and-leakage-control.md) — market-time correctness
- [Appendix](https://finance-agents.dev/appendix.md) — models, surveys, neighboring lists

## Use with AI / 在 AI 里使用

- [Home (Markdown)](https://finance-agents.dev/index.md) / [中文首页](https://finance-agents.dev/zh/index.md)
- [projects.json](https://finance-agents.dev/projects.json): every entry with chapter, section, English and Chinese descriptions, and tags
- MCP (read-only, Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://mcp.finance-agents.dev/mcp — tools: search_projects, list_chapters, get_chapter, get_project
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http finance-agents https://mcp.finance-agents.dev/mcp`
